answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a wander bet on surviving 81 epochs of grading, and every voyage settlement recomputes the willow schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 81 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
